text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So that Kiseki could think of
"an amazing run that surpasses past Kikuka Sho Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...It took some time,
but after several weeks, the preparations are finally complete."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now, our time may be short, but I look forward to working with you. I am Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf, the "Emperor", who achieved
the first undefeated Classic Triple Crown in history.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I'm gonna blow right past everyone here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "Monster" Narita Brian, who delivered
a shocking 7-length blowout in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, looks like we're all here~
Then let's get right to it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "Turf Director," Mr. C.B.,
who conquered the Kikuka Sho with an unconventional run
that left everyone in sheer astonishment.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
T-To think I'm really... running alongside these three...!!
Wait, these people are all—
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's run with the "Triple Crown Umamusume".
Yeah, let's run with the "Triple Crown Umamusume".

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Why did the races of the Triple Crown Umamusume excite people's hearts so much?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If you wish to know that,
—the best way is to experience it firsthand.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Foolish creature.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: What is there to speak of without me?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Even Orfevre-senpai?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one and only "Gilded Tyrant" Orfevre,
said to have captured the Triple Crown and brought hope to the masses.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She had turned down participating until just now... but seeing the lineup seems to have piqued her interest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It is a spectacular sight to see Triple Crown Umamusume gathered together.
It takes my breath away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bracing myself, I reconsider the situation.
Both Symboli Rudolf and Narita Brian
are Umamusume capable of running as pace-setters.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In contrast, Mr. C.B. and Orfevre are Umamusume famous for racing from behind...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: If I can take in their running in the flesh...!
choice_data_list: Let's run behind Orfe and the others
Let's run ahead of Rudolf and the others

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ~~...gh, understood!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rumble rumble rumble...!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... What incredible power...!
Kicking up so much dust, too...!

text_block_list.name: C.B. & Orfe
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaah!!
Haaaaaaahhh--!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Goosebumps spread, I can't take my eyes off them.
â..."Just how far will they go?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: What came to mind was a blank manuscript.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —They are the "unknown."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Watching them made my heart dance.
I felt like I was witnessing "something completely new."
The excitement inside my chest felt like it was about to explode—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Thump-thump, thump-thump, thump-thump!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*... *pant*...!
...*gasp*...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Um, may, I, ask a question...!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Where is it you are headed...!
What kind of heights will your running reach...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Mmm. Since it's hot right now,
I feel like going to get some ice cream.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hoh, ice, is it?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Offer me a bite
of that orange below.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: An orange? Is that for me?!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Oh. In that case, Kiseki,
I'll give you all my chocolate.
I got tired of it.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
!? But CB-senpai was just saying
she wanted to eat chocolate...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha.
Let me savor it however I like.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Both races and ice cream. ...Right?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"It is just as they say.
Now then, Kiseki."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...It is the King's command.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Eep, Orfe-senpai!? All right!
I'll share! I'll get a bite ready for you right away~!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Kiseki spent some time
interacting with the Triple Crown Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ~~...gh, understood!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rumble rumble rumble...!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... President Rudolf and the others are still behind me...!
I should have had the lead this whole time, and yet...!

text_block_list.name: Rudolf & Brian
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaaaaahhh--!!
DAAAAAAAAGHHH!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
My heart trembles, a chill runs down my spine.
"This tension won't let up until we cross the finish line"—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
What came to mind was
the image of the two of them backed by a blank manuscript.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —They are "boundless."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ideals set too high, a hunger left unsatisfied—
she refuses to make any compromises with herself.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"That is why I can go anywhere.
Surpassing even the limits everyone knows—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Thump-thump, thump-thump, thump-thump!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*... *pant*...!
...*gasp*... *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Shall we call it a day?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: No!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I can still run! I can still keep up!
One more time, please!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hooh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I like it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Kiseki trained alongside
the Triple Crown Umamusume until her stamina ran out—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, good work out there. Since we're here,
shall we enjoy our summer wrap-up party?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much!
I-I'll eat a whole bunch!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Chuckle, please relax.
Exchanging thoughts with the younger generation
is one of my greatest pleasures, you see.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Heh...
You're making quite an aged face.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
With fangs like those,
you won't even be able to tear through flesh.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh. I would have thought you were the one
who needed vegetables more than meat.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wha...
Wha-wha-what...?!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: So cool...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, Kiseki seems to be
quite a delightful child.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Come now, you have such an adorable junior here.
Brian, as the cool senior you are,
why don't you have a chat with Kiseki too?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And made sure to enjoy their brief interaction.
